hooks.name: Plain-language review of prompt changes
hooks.description: Prompts are where jargon leaks into Frank's speech; an agent reads the change the way the user will hear it.

action.prompt: A file that shapes what Frank says to the user was just saved. Invoke the Plain Language Auditor sub-agent on that file only. It must check (1) every example reply and instruction in the prompt for music jargon a non-musician would not know (tempo, BPM, key, reverb, compression, EQ, stem, MIDI, LUFS, quantise and the like) without a plain translation, and (2) that the prompt still tells the model to speak plainly. Report each finding with the line and a plain replacement. Do not edit the file.
